_comment: Hand-maintained rules for /tools/structured-output-schema-checker/. Each rule quotes its official source. Tested by assets/js/tools/tests/schema.test.mjs.

targets.label: OpenAI Structured Outputs / strict function calling

formats.label: Anthropic Messages tool
formats.quote: `input_schema`: A JSON Schema object defining the expected parameters for the tool.

rules.title: Root must be an object, not anyOf

source.quote: Note that the root level object of a schema must be an object, and not use `anyOf`.

rules.title: Every object needs additionalProperties: false

source.quote: Structured Outputs only supports generating specified keys / values, so we require developers to set `additionalProperties: false` to opt into Structured Outputs.

rules.title: Every property must be listed in required
rules.detail: To keep a field optional, make its type nullable (for example `["string", "null"]`). The auto-fix does this.

source.quote: To use Structured Outputs, all fields or function parameters must be specified as `required`.

rules.title: allOf, not, if/then/else and dependent* aren't supported

source.quote: **Composition:** `allOf`, `not`, `dependentRequired`, `dependentSchemas`, `if`, `then`, `else`

rules.title: Size limits: 5,000 properties, 10 levels of nesting, 1,000 enum values

source.quote: A schema may have up to 5000 object properties total, with up to 10 levels of nesting.

rules.title: String format isn't in OpenAI's supported list

source.quote: `format` — Predefined formats for strings. Currently supported: `date-time`, `time`, `date`, `duration`, `email`, `hostname`, `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `uuid`

rules.title: Every object needs additionalProperties: false

source.quote: `required` and `additionalProperties` (must be set to `false` for objects)

rules.title: minimum, maximum and multipleOf aren't supported
rules.detail: The auto-fix moves each constraint into the description, as Anthropic's SDK helpers do, so validate the value in your code.

source.quote: Numerical constraints (such as `minimum`, `maximum`, `multipleOf`)

rules.title: minLength and maxLength aren't supported

source.quote: String constraints (`minLength`, `maxLength`)

rules.title: Only minItems of 0 or 1 is supported on arrays

source.quote: Array constraints beyond `minItems` of 0 or 1

rules.title: Recursive schemas aren't supported

source.quote: Recursive schemas

rules.title: External $ref isn't supported

source.quote: External `$ref` (for example, `'$ref': 'http://...'`)

rules.title: Enums can only hold strings, numbers, booleans or null

source.quote: `enum` (strings, numbers, booleans, or nulls only, no complex types)

rules.title: allOf with $ref isn't supported

source.quote: `anyOf` and `allOf` (with limitations: `allOf` with `$ref` not supported)

rules.title: At most 24 optional parameters across all strict schemas in a request

source.quote: Total optional parameters across all strict tool schemas and JSON output schemas. Each parameter not listed in `required` counts toward this limit.

rules.title: At most 16 parameters with union types across all strict schemas

source.quote: Total parameters that use `anyOf` or type arrays (for example, `"type": ["string", "null"]`) across all strict schemas.

rules.title: String format isn't in Anthropic's supported list

source.quote: String formats: `date-time`, `time`, `date`, `duration`, `email`, `hostname`, `uri`, `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `uuid`

rules.title: pattern uses an unsupported regex feature

source.quote: Backreferences to groups (for example, `\1`, `\2`) … Lookahead/lookbehind assertions … Word boundaries: `\b`, `\B`

rules.title: Constraint is ignored by Gemini
rules.detail: The API strips it instead of returning an error, so validate it in your code. The auto-fix removes it so the schema says what's actually enforced.

source.quote: `minLength`, `maxLength`, `minProperties`, `maxProperties`, `uniqueItems`, `contains`, `minContains`, and `maxContains` (and their snake_case variants) are not enforced by the constrained decoding grammar engine.

rules.title: type isn't one Gemini supports

source.quote: The following values of `type` are supported: string, number, integer, boolean, object, array, null

rules.title: Large enum, anyOf or nested array limit (common cause of 400s)
rules.detail: Google doesn't publish exact limits. We flag enums over 100 values, anyOf over 10 alternatives and maxItems over 100 on nested arrays.

source.quote: Common causes are large `maxItems` limits (especially on nested arrays), very long property or enum names, enums with many values, long runs of optional properties, `anyOf` with many alternatives, and numeric `minimum`/`maximum` bounds.
